name: begins-chain
description: Each x is an 'a' that a further x follows, which a nested begins() over the rest of the text decides. So the queries nest as deep as the text is long, and the last x is a 'b' (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {x}
%rule x 'a'
%conditions begins(after($), x)
%extend-rule x 'b'
